kpi.name: Students Enrolled
kpi.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daep_placements WHERE tenant_id = :tenantId AND status = 'active'

kpi.name: Attendance Rate
kpi.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('P', 'T')) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM daep_attendance WHERE tenant_id = :tenantId AND date = CURRENT_DATE
kpi.trend: Compare to same day last week
kpi.icon: Calendar (green when up, red when down)

kpi.name: Pending Approvals
kpi.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daep_daily_points WHERE tenant_id = :tenantId AND approval_status = 'pending'

kpi.name: Recidivism Rate
kpi.description: Students with multiple placements / total completed placements
kpi.format: Percentage with breakdown by discipline code
